svg.title: System map: interface to infrastructure
svg.desc: Six engineering modules. M1 Product engineering: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native. M2 Backend systems: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs, WebSockets, Socket.IO. M3 Data layer: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Prisma. M4 Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, Linux, Nginx, GitHub Actions pipeline from commit to deploy. M5 Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki. M6 AI engineering, marked as active exploration: Python, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, MCP, AI agents, Qdrant, Pinecone, Neo4j.
svg.text: INTERFACE TO INFRASTRUCTURE / HOW THE PIECES I WORK WITH CONNECT
agents call services via APIs and MCP
solid = what I build and run dashed = what I am actively exploring
